messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 ALERT — service=gateway severity=critical — p99 latency spike 3.2s (baseline ~0.6s), 5xx rate 4.8% over last 5m. Pager -> @andrew
andrew: on it. looking at dashboards now. any recent deploys?
sam: saw a full rollout at 11:30 UTC (release-2026-03-15). canary at 11:12 then promoted at 11:30.
maria: logs show a ton of `rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded` and `upstream timeout` starting ~11:33. correlates w/ p99.
andrew: running quick smoke against a few hosts
```
$ curl -s -D - -o /dev/null https://gateway-us-east.internal/v1/invoke -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n"
504 1.87
200 0.45
504 2.34
```
results are mixed — some backends fine, some returning 504s.
jordan: checking connection pool health and keepalive stats. upstream backend latency has tail spikes, connections exhausted on some nodes. could be a runtime change to multiplexing or pool sizing.
keri: I can trigger rollback to previous stable (release-2026-03-14-rc2) if you want a quick mitigation.
andrew: do it. prioritize traffic stability. start rollback to rc2, monitor p95/p99 and 5xx. mark as `rollback-in-progress`.
deploy-bot: rollback request accepted. pipeline: rollback -> rollout to 25% -> 50% -> 100%. initiated by andrew, request_id=rb-35278901.
sam: rolling back now. starting 25% -> 50% -> 100% (tracking in deploy console).
maria: posting a sample error trace to the thread for triage:
```
[11:34:12] gateway-12 - grpc deadline exceeded - trace_id=abc123 - upstream=kvcache-03 
stack: gateway/handler.go:214 -> router/proxy.go:89 -> http/client.go:57
```
andrew: after rollback hit ~50% p99 for the 50% pool dropped from 3.2s -> 0.9s. still watching.
deploy-bot: rollback completed to release-2026-03-14-rc2 across 100% at 11:40 UTC.
jordan: metrics update: p99 back to 0.62s, 5xx down to 0.3% cluster-wide. looks like immediate mitigation successful.
product-ops: brief customer-impact note: ~0.4% of API calls failed for ~8 minutes during peak; customer-facing SLO breach window ~11:33-11:42. we should notify top-5 affected customers, CS team on it.
andrew: agreed. product-ops please lead comms. creating incident ticket and setting status page.
incident-bot: incident created INC-2026-1757 — link: https://incidents.redwood.internal/INC-2026-1757 (auto-generated). severity=sev2.
maria: archived relevant logs to s3://redwood-logs/incidents/INC-2026-1757/ and uploaded a subset to the debug-runbook. added grep commands + exact trace_ids.
jordan: quick hypothesis: the new runtime flag that changed connection multiplexing combined with slightly lower keepalive timeouts caused head-of-line blocking under certain traffic mixes. cause still speculative.
keri: handoff: i'll be on next 2h monitoring. next steps I will own: 1) keep an eye on p95/p99 dashboards 2) follow up with infra on connection pool telemetry 3) validate canary tests for multiplexing flag.
andrew: thx. please add the rollback playbook run and the exact timing to the incident ticket. we should also add a short regression test to CI to catch the deadline patterns.
product-ops: comms drafted and sent to customers affected; CS will follow up with impacted accounts.
andrew: one-line blameless summary for handoff: new deploy (release-2026-03-15) introduced a runtime/pool change that correlated with p99/timeouts; rollback to previous release restored latency and reduced 5xx. full RCA to follow.
keri: ack — will monitor and own RCA coordination. opening a follow-up ticket: RCA-352789. assigning to eng-runtime + eng-ml for potential kv cache interaction.
maria: adding reproduction steps to the ticket and saving a minimized load script. snippet:
```bash
# simulate mix with long-context requests
hey() { for i in {1..200}; do curl -s https://gateway-us-east.internal/v1/invoke -d '{"prompt":"long..."}' & done; wait; }
hey
```
andrew: excellent. folks, paging/ops debrief at 13:00 UTC to decide whether to revert the flag or adjust pool sizing permanently.
product-ops: posting to status.redwood: "Partial API degradation resolved. Investigating root cause. Customers notified."
andrew: closing immediate pager — leaving the thread open for RCA updates. great fast roll back and comms. :thumbsup:
